messages:
alex: Quick summary - onboarding obsidian-ranker-v2 (fp16 -> PTQ int4) cold smoke: ndcg@10 up, mrr@1 down on holdout_v3. any quick hypotheses? :thinking_face:

maya: Could be tie/collapse from quant buckets. Did you run identical candidate pool + dedupe?

alex: Yes. Repro cmd I used:
```
python eval_rerank.py --model obsidian-v2-int4 --candidates candidates_v1.jsonl --holdout holdout_v3 --metrics ndcg@10,mrr@1 --seed 42
```

jorge: Share topk stats - tiny gaps or many equal tops will tank mrr.

alex: quick diag:
# top1 std: 0.032
# mean gap r1-r2: 0.0012
# fraction top1==top2: 0.018

liz: 1.8% equals is high. What quant recipe?

alex: PTQ, per-channel asymmetric, quantlib-v0.9, no bias-correction.

maya: Try two ablations: (A) per-tensor symmetric for last linear, (B) bias-correction on final layer. Also candidate-shuffle to check tie interplay.

jorge: Add slice by query frequency (head/mid/tail) — tail often suffers.

alex: Running ablations now, will post results.

(2h later)

alex: Results:
- fp16 baseline: ndcg@10 0.412, mrr@1 0.273
- int4-default: ndcg@10 0.424 (+2.9%), mrr@1 0.262 (-4.0%)
- int4-per-tensor-sym-last: ndcg@10 0.421, mrr@1 0.268
- int4-bias-corr-last: ndcg@10 0.419, mrr@1 0.271
- int4-shuffle: ndcg@10 0.423, mrr@1 0.263

maya: bias-corr almost recovers mrr. ndcg remains higher from quant reorderings.

alex: Slice table (baseline -> int4-bias-corr):
head: 0.451 -> 0.455 (mrr 0.312 -> 0.318)
mid: 0.426 -> 0.427 (mrr 0.279 -> 0.281)
tail: 0.398 -> 0.411 (mrr 0.177 -> 0.205)

liz: Tail improvement indicates small-gap stabilization from bias-correction. Good candidate for default recipe.

maya: Ops checklist: 1) add bias-corr to quant pipeline, 2) add per-slice metrics to onboarding CI, 3) canary with 5% shadow, auto-rollback if mrr@1 drops >2% over 6h.

jorge: Also quick temp-scaling experiment (softmax temp 0.95/1.05) as backup knob.

alex: I'll implement bias-corr PR and add slice outputs. @maya please create canary config.

maya: Creating canary now, will post link. Auto-rollback rule + shadow compare for 48h.

alex: Thanks team. Plan: roll int4-bias-corr in shadow, collect online proxies and per-slice metrics, escalate if head mrr degrades. PR will be posted here. :thumbsup:
